difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for f : X -> S flat, locally of finite presentation, with every nonempty fibre equidimensional of dimension d, the closed subscheme Z cut out by Fit_d of Omega_{X/S} is exactly the set of points where f is not smooth (source lines 1614-1626). The proof identifies the complement of Z with the locus where Omega_{X/S} can be generated by at most d elements, using the rank-strata lemma, and concludes with the standard criterion for smoothness at a point in terms of d generators of the differentials.
